panels.title: % Invalid Rows per Ingestion Run
panels.description: Trend of invalid-row percentage per ingestion run. Thresholds mirror the DAG's own criticality bands: <10% low, 10-50% medium, >50% high.

targets.rawSql: SELECT timestamp AS time, filename, CASE WHEN total_rows = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (invalid_rows::float / total_rows) * 100 END AS invalid_pct FROM ingestion_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) ORDER BY timestamp

panels.title: Error Category Trend (last window)
panels.description: Row-level error counts per category over time — completeness, validity, consistency, schema, type.

targets.rawSql: SELECT timestamp AS time, COALESCE((error_types->>'null_value')::int, 0) AS completeness_null_value, COALESCE((error_types->>'out_of_range')::int, 0) AS validity_out_of_range, COALESCE((error_types->>'invalid_categorical')::int, 0) AS consistency_invalid_categorical, COALESCE((error_types->>'missing_column')::int, 0) AS schema_missing_column, COALESCE((error_types->>'wrong_type')::int, 0) AS type_wrong_type FROM ingestion_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) ORDER BY timestamp

panels.title: Most Frequent Error Types (selected window)
panels.description: Aggregate count per error category across all ingestion runs in the selected time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'Completeness (null)' AS error_category, SUM(COALESCE((error_types->>'null_value')::int,0)) AS count FROM ingestion_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) UNION ALL SELECT 'Validity (out of range)', SUM(COALESCE((error_types->>'out_of_range')::int,0)) FROM ingestion_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) UNION ALL SELECT 'Consistency (invalid categorical)', SUM(COALESCE((error_types->>'invalid_categorical')::int,0)) FROM ingestion_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) UNION ALL SELECT 'Schema (missing column)', SUM(COALESCE((error_types->>'missing_column')::int,0)) FROM ingestion_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) UNION ALL SELECT 'Type (wrong type)', SUM(COALESCE((error_types->>'wrong_type')::int,0)) FROM ingestion_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) ORDER BY count DESC

panels.title: Ingestion Runs by Criticality
panels.description: Count of ingestion runs per criticality level over time — spot spikes in high/medium criticality batches.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(timestamp, '1m') AS time, criticality, COUNT(*) AS runs FROM ingestion_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY 1, criticality ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Recent Ingestion Runs
panels.description: Latest ingestion batches for quick inspection during the demo.

targets.rawSql: SELECT timestamp, filename, total_rows, valid_rows, invalid_rows, criticality FROM ingestion_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 20
